speak.title: Role-play: what to do with the old clothes
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the housemate who wants to donate
a.text: You and your housemate have six bags of old clothes. You want to give everything to a charity shop this weekend. Explain why, and listen to your housemate's idea.

b.role: the housemate who wants to sell
b.text: You want to sell the best clothes online and give the rest to charity. Explain why, and ask what the charity shop will do with damaged items. Try to agree on a plan.

phrases: I'd like to give everything to the charity shop.
That's a fair point, but it'll take a lot of time.
What if we sell the best pieces online?
I'm not keen on that, because it's a lot of work.
How about we split the bags in two?
Let's check every item before we decide.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: what did you decide to do with the clothes, and why?
